summary: PR 2826 at exact commit 45edfe6adc673223d69098db3524f1052de7ef15 adds pre-Ampere CUDA gates to all three reported JIT families, including the standalone QKNorm path omitted by its parent candidate. Independent simulated-sm_75 checks fail on the recorded base and pass on the candidate without invoking loaders; ROCm remains enabled and executes correctly on the assigned GPU.

tests.what_was_measured: Expected failing-before: simulated sm_75 returned standalone=True, fused_rope=True, eligible_residual=True and recorded all three loader/eligibility events.
Passing-after with the identical independent check: all three results were false and no loader was called.
Candidate regression suite: 17 passed, covering pre-Ampere rejection, sm_80/sm_90/sm_121 acceptance, ROCm exemption, and loader suppression.
AMD Instinct MI355X ROCm exemption and real residual-gate HIP JIT execution; fp32 output matched a CPU-fp64 reference with max_abs=0.0.

gpu_execution_evidence: One AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950 family), Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2; residual-gate HIP JIT executed and matched the independent reference exactly.
remaining_limitations: No NVIDIA sm_75 GPU or pip CUDA 13 plus host-glibc environment was available, so the exact rsqrt/rsqrtf diagnostic and compiler latency were not directly reproduced.
FLUX.2-klein-4B weights were unavailable, so full denoise first-step latency and model semantics were not measured.
No native source changed; native rebuild was therefore not applicable. The reviewed Python modules imported from the checkout and the prepared sgl_kernel package imported from the environment.
